_comment: CFIS donor entity id -> verified org domain for logo display. Every entry is human-verified: the domain's homepage must identify the organization, and the committee-to-org link must be self-evident from the committee's registered name (or verified on the org's own site). Entries failing either check are excluded, never guessed. The build's logo fetcher re-verifies homepages before fetching (scripts/fetch-logos.mjs).

651839.basis: self-named acronym; weac.org homepage identifies WEAC (verified 2026-08-20)

651935.basis: WRA's RPAC; wra.org homepage identifies Wisconsin REALTORS (verified 2026-08-20)

664011.committee: Wisconsin Association of Health Plans PAC

16896.basis: the org itself; wisgop.org homepage identifies Republican Party of Wisconsin (verified 2026-08-20)

651856.basis: self-named; wisbeer.com homepage titled Wisconsin Beer Distributors Association (verified 2026-08-20, confirmed by Henry)
